notes.title: Bride into the Cave Demo is OUT
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of the official demo for Bride into the Cave!

When the four of us first came together, we never imagined that we would be able to create a game like this. But here we are, presenting you with our demo and potentially a full version early next year.

The demo features Japanese, Chinese, and English localizations, and includes 2 chapters. We will continue to add more elements and characters to further enrich the story. 

We hope you enjoy it! Feel free to join our Discord if you have any suggestions regarding gameplay or localization. 

And of course,

WISHLIST US!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/Bride_into_the_Cave/
